name: active_queries
description:
Active queries. This tool can determine currently active queries in the VictoriaMetrics instance.
This information is obtained from the "/api/v1/status/active_queries" HTTP endpoint of VictoriaMetrics API.

name: alerts
description: List of firing and pending alerts of the VictoriaMetrics instance. This tool uses `/api/v1/alerts` endpoint of vmalert API, proxied by VictoriaMetrics API.

group.description: Filter alerts by their group name. If not specified, all groups are included.
group.title: Filter by alert group

limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return. If not specified, all alerts are returned.
limit.title: Limit the number of alerts

offset.description: Number of alerts to skip before starting to collect the result set. Default is 0.
offset.title: Offset for pagination

state.description: Filter alerts by their state. Possible values: 'firing', 'pending', 'all'. Default is 'all'.
state.title: Filter by alert state

name: documentation
description: Search documentation resources for the given search query, returning the URIs of the resources that match the search criteria sorted by relevance. This tool can help to get context for any VictoriaMetrics related question.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return
limit.title: Maximum number of results

query.description: Query for search (for example, list of keywords)
query.title: Search query

query.description: MetricsQL or PromQL expression for explanation
query.title: MetricsQL or PromQL expression

name: label_values
description: List of label values from VictoriaMetrics instance for a provided label name. This tool uses `/api/v1/label/{labelName}/values` endpoint of VictoriaMetrics API.

end.description: End timestamp for selection labels values
end.title: End timestamp

label_name.description: Name of the label to query its values
label_name.title: Label name

limit.description: Maximum number of label values to return
limit.title: Maximum number of label values

match.description: Time series selector argument that selects the series from which to read the label values
match.title: Match series for labels values

start.description: Start timestamp for selection labels values
start.title: Start timestamp

name: labels
description: List of label names of the VictoriaMetrics instance. This tools uses `/api/v1/labels` endpoint of VictoriaMetrics API.

end.description: End timestamp for selection labels names
end.title: End timestamp

limit.description: Maximum number of label names to return
limit.title: Maximum number of label names

match.description: Time series selector argument that selects the series from which to read the label names
match.title: Match series for label names

start.description: Start timestamp for selection labels names
start.title: Start timestamp

name: metric_statistics
description: Statistics of metrics usage in queries of the VictoriaMetrics instance. This tool helps to identify unused (never queried) or rarely used metrics or conversely actively queried metrics. This tool uses `/api/v1/status/metric_names_stats` endpoint of VictoriaMetrics API.

le.description: less than or equal, is an integer threshold for filtering metric names by their usage count in queries. For example, with ?le=1 API returns metric names that were queried <=1 times.
le.title: Less than or equal

limit.description: Integer value to limit the number of metric names in response. By default, API returns 1000 records.
limit.title: Maximum number of metric names

match_pattern.description: A regex pattern to match metric names for showing usage statistics. For example, ?match_pattern=vm_ will match any metric names with vm_ pattern, like vm_http_requests, max_vm_memory_available.
match_pattern.title: A regex pattern to match metric names

name: metrics
description: List of available metrics of the VictoriaMetrics instance. This tool uses `/api/v1/label/__name__/values` endpoint of VictoriaMetrics API.

end.description: End timestamp for selection metric names
end.title: End timestamp

limit.description: Maximum number of metric names to return
limit.title: Maximum number of metric names

match.description: Time series selector argument that selects the series from which to read the metrics
match.title: Match series for metric names

start.description: Start timestamp for selection metric names
start.title: Start timestamp

name: metrics_metadata
description: Returns stored metrics details (metadata) such as name, type, help (description), and unit, and can be used to generate natural language queries. This tool uses `/api/v1/metadata` endpoint of VictoriaMetrics API.

limit.description: Maximum number of metrics to return
limit.title: Maximum number of metrics

metric.description: A metric name to filter metadata for. All metric metadata is retrieved if left empty
metric.title: Metric name

search.description: A keyword for search in description and metric name
search.title: Search keyword

type.description: The metric type by which the list of metrics will be filtered
type.title: Metric type name

unit.description: The unit by which the list of metrics will be filtered
unit.title: Unit name

name: prettify_query
description: Prettify (format) MetricsQL query. This tool uses `/prettify-query` endpoint of VictoriaMetrics API.

query.description: MetricsQL or PromQL expression for prettification. This is the query that will be formatted.
query.title: MetricsQL or PromQL expression

name: query
description: Instant query executes PromQL or MetricsQL query expression at the given time. The result of Instant query is a list of time series matching the filter in query expression. Each returned series contains exactly one (timestamp, value) entry, where timestamp equals to the time query arg, while the value contains query result at the requested time. This tool uses `/api/v1/query` endpoint of VictoriaMetrics API.

nocache.description: If true, the query will not use the rollup cache on execution.
nocache.title: Disable cache

query.description: MetricsQL or PromQL expression for the query of the data
query.title: MetricsQL or PromQL expression

step.description: Optional interval for searching for raw samples in the past when executing the query (used when a sample is missing at the specified time). For example, the request /api/v1/query?query=up&step=1m looks for the last written raw sample for the metric up in the (now()-1m, now()] interval (the first millisecond is not included). If omitted, step is set to 5m (5 minutes) by default.
step.title: Step

time.description: Timestamp in millisecond precision to evaluate the query at. If omitted, time is set to now() (current timestamp). The time param can be specified in multiple allowed formats.
time.title: Timestamp

timeout.description: Optional query timeout. For example, timeout=5s. Query is canceled when the timeout is reached. By default the timeout is set to the value of -search.maxQueryDuration command-line flag passed to single-node VictoriaMetrics or to vmselect component of VictoriaMetrics cluster.
timeout.title: Timeout

trace.description: If true, the query will be traced and the trace will be returned in the response. This is useful for debugging and performance analysis.
trace.title: Enable query trace

name: query_range
description: Range query executes the query expression at the given [start…end] time range with the given step. The result of Range query is a list of time series matching the filter in query expression. Each returned series contains (timestamp, value) results for the query executed at start, start+step, start+2*step, …, start+N*step timestamps. In other words, Range query is an Instant query executed independently at start, start+step, …, start+N*step timestamps with the only difference that an instant query does not return ephemeral samples (see below). Instead, if the database does not contain any samples for the requested time and step, it simply returns an empty result. This tool uses `/api/v1/query_range` endpoint of VictoriaMetrics API.

end.description: The ending timestamp of the time range for query evaluation. If the end isn’t set, then the end is automatically set to the current time.
end.title: End timestamp

nocache.description: If true, the query will not use the rollup cache on execution.
nocache.title: Disable cache

query.description: MetricsQL or PromQL expression for the query of the data
query.title: MetricsQL or PromQL expression

start.description: The starting timestamp of the time range for query evaluation
start.title: Start timestamp

step.description: the interval between data points, which must be returned from the range query. The query is executed at start, start+step, start+2*step, …, start+N*step timestamps, where N is the whole number of steps that fit between start and end. end is included only when it equals to start+N*step. If the step isn’t set, then it default to 5m (5 minutes).
step.title: Step

timeout.description: optional query timeout. For example, timeout=5s. Query is canceled when the timeout is reached. By default the timeout is set to the value of -search.maxQueryDuration command-line flag passed to single-node VictoriaMetrics or to vmselect component in VictoriaMetrics cluster.
timeout.title: Timeout

trace.description: If true, the query will be traced and the trace will be returned in the response. This is useful for debugging and performance analysis.
trace.title: Enable query trace

name: rules
description: List of alerting and recording rules of VictoriaMetrics instance. This tool uses `/api/v1/rules` endpoint of vmalert API proxied by VictoriaMetrics API.

filter.description: Extra filter for rules with possible problems: unhealthy (rules that get some errors during evaluation) or noMatch (rules that don't match any time series)
filter.title: Extra filter for rules

type.description: Rules type to be displayed: alert or record
type.title: Rules type

name: series
description: List of available time series of the VictoriaMetrics instance. This tool uses `/api/v1/series` endpoint of VictoriaMetrics API.

end.description: End timestamp for selection time series
end.title: End timestamp

limit.description: Maximum number of time series to return
limit.title: Maximum number of time series

match.description: Time series selector argument that selects the series
match.title: Match series

start.description: Start timestamp for selection time series
start.title: Start timestamp

name: top_queries

maxLifetime.description: Max lifetime of the queries to be taken into account during stats calculation. By default is 10m.
maxLifetime.title: Max lifetime

topN.description: The number of top entries to return in the response. By default is 20.
topN.title: Top N

name: tsdb_status
description:
The following tool returns various cardinality statistics about the VictoriaMetrics TSDB:
- Metric names with the highest number of series.
- Labels with the highest number of series.
- Values with the highest number of series for the selected label (aka focusLabel).
- label=name pairs with the highest number of series.
- Labels with the highest number of unique values.

This tool returns TSDB stats from "/api/v1/status/tsdb" endpoint of VictoriaMetrics API (in the way similar to Prometheus).

date.description: The date for collecting the stats. By default, the stats is collected for the current day. Pass date=1970-01-01 in order to collect global stats across all the days.
date.title: Date

extraLabel.description: Optional extra_label=<label_name>=<label_value> query arg, which can be used for enforcing additional label filters for queries. For example, /api/v1/query_range?extra_label=user_id=123&extra_label=group_id=456&query=<query> would automatically add {user_id="123",group_id="456"} label filters to the given <query>. This functionality can be used for limiting the scope of time series visible to the given tenant.
extraLabel.title: Extra label

focusLabel.description: Returns label values with the highest number of time series for the given label name in the seriesCountByFocusLabelValue list.
focusLabel.title: Focus label

match.description: Arbitrary time series selector for series to take into account during stats calculation. By default all the series are taken into account.
match.title: Match series selector

topN.description: is the number of top entries to return in the response
topN.title: Top N
